name: @suryaappq/xcut
description: Linux Wi-Fi/BLE security toolkit: ARP cut, deauth flood (aireplay/mdk4), monitor mode, BLE spoof (vendor class, hop/scan), soft-jam. Linux-only - needs kernel-level access (raw sockets, monitor mode, MGMT channel).

scripts.postinstall: echo 'xcut installed. Kernel deps (iw, aircrack-ng, etc.) still needed - see README or run: ./install.sh --deps-only'
